title: Cartagena Legacy Periphery Network - Lines 14, 24 and 25
notes: Optional representation metadata. It is not authoritative simulation state.
Sixth and final inner Cartagena component, containing Lines 14, 24 and 25.
Line 14 preserves fifteen separately published workings without flattening Fuente Álamo, La Aljorra, El Albujón, Los Mateos or Lomas variants.
Line 24 preserves four independently published Cartagena/Pozo Estrecho/Roldán workings.
Line 25 is a source-supported Zona Oeste cycle: the raw terminal repeat of stop 5311 is omitted from stopNodeIds and represented once by closesLoop=true.
Route style colors are presentation-only and are not claimed as operator livery.
